title: This is GhostHeart.
summary: The name, the scars, and the reason a hidden heart chose to be seen.
paragraphs: GhostHeart is one lived story told through music, film, words, and visual storytelling. The music is a way into the larger story.
The heart survived. Then it chose a purpose.
GhostHeart begins with a life. It reaches toward people who need to feel seen, find their footing, and take their next step.

title: GhostHeart’s Oath
summary: The promise to protect the light in others.
paragraphs: Meet the heart behind the name. Then hear the promise it chose to carry.
The promise to protect the light in others.
What survived can help someone rise.

title: You’re Not God
summary: You can have your beliefs. You do not get to play God.
paragraphs: YOU’RE NOT GOD is for everyone who has been judged, shamed, controlled, or cast aside by people claiming they speak for heaven.

This album is not an attack on faith. It is a confrontation with hypocrisy—the preacher demanding purity while hiding their own sins, the believer using scripture as a weapon, and anyone who mistakes personal hatred for God’s voice.
From That Ain’t Holy to Hey Preacher Man, these songs expose what happens when love is replaced by fear, compassion becomes control, and religion is used to excuse cruelty.
No human gets to decide whose life has value, whose love is real, or who deserves grace. You can stand behind a pulpit, a title, or a crowd—but you are still human.
